desc: The Breek-LOK system revolutionizes the quick-detach process, allowing operators to attach and remove suppressors swiftly and confidently, whether in the field, at the range, or during tactical operations. At the core of this system lies the Breek-LOK 3QD HUB, a state-of-the-art quick-attach mount engineered to outclass conventional solutions in both performance and weight savings. Precision-machined from aerospace-grade titanium, the HUB weighs an impressively light 2.3 ounces. This weight advantage not only reduces overall rifle burden but also improves handling, maneuverability, and speed of target acquisition. The HUBs tri-lug engagement system interfaces seamlessly with the specially designed muzzle devices. When combined, they form a robust, repeatable attachment that stands up to the most demanding firing conditions. Adding only 1.15 inches to the overall length of the suppressor, the sleek, minimalistic profile ensures that the HUB maintains a low footprint, blending tastefully into the firearms silhouette without compromising aesthetics or performance.
